description:
Wire everything together and validate.

## Work

- `Filament.LiveView.render/1` calls `Filament.Web.RenderToRendered.convert/3` on the vnode-tree assign and feeds the resulting `%Rendered{}` to PLV's diff engine.
- Remove the transitional shim from flm-3wr.1.2.
- Migrate examples (todo, cart, collaboration, inventory) to confirm they still render correctly. `~F` templates should work unchanged after the codegen switch; only adapter-level wiring may need touching.
- Audit substrate modules for residual `Phoenix.LiveView.*` references; remove any that remain.

## Validation

- `mix test` — all 329+ tests pass.
- `mix credo --strict` — clean.
- `mix dialyzer` — clean (no new warnings).
- Each example boots in Chrome; representative interaction flows verified:
  - **todo**: add, toggle, remove, filter
  - **cart**: add multiple, remove, multiple item types
  - **collaboration**: cross-tab lock takeover, presence count, lock auto-release on tab close
  - **inventory**: per-tab holds, depletion, disconnect auto-release
- WebSocket frames: keyed comprehensions still emit `"k"`/`"kc"`; fiber-id wire refs (`root.Mod[key=N]:slot`) unchanged from baseline.
- `grep -r "Phoenix.LiveView" lib/filament/{reconciler,renderer,hooks,fiber,fiber_tree,render_context,vnode}.ex` returns nothing.

## Files

- `lib/filament/live_view.ex`
- Possibly examples (only if adapter-level changes need them; templates should stay clean).

## Acceptance

- All five validation criteria above hold.
- Substrate grep-clean of `Phoenix.LiveView`.
- Wire format unchanged from pre-epic baseline for representative cases.
title: Phase 1.5: LiveView wiring + examples + Chrome validation
